question: Should OpenClaw accept selectable quick-fix and full-change PR templates as the contributor PR authoring path?
rationale: The patch is technically focused and uses GitHub-supported template mechanics, but it changes maintainer/contributor workflow policy and the linked issue is already marked as needing product direction.

options.title: Accept Current Split
options.body: Merge after normal exact-head checks and any needed branch refresh because the templates preserve OpenClaw's required proof headings and use supported GitHub selection URLs.

options.title: Request Template Policy Edits
options.body: Ask for narrower wording or additional contributor-guide changes before merge if maintainers want a different quick/full contract.

options.title: Reject Selectable Templates
options.body: Close this PR and keep the single fallback template if maintainers prefer one authoring path for all contributors.

recommendation.title: Accept Current Split
recommendation.body: Merge after normal exact-head checks and any needed branch refresh because the templates preserve OpenClaw's required proof headings and use supported GitHub selection URLs.
